final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT r.name, r.rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS above_average FROM r, a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC
